task: Split a song into a vocal track and an instrumental backing track
packaging_note: Runs upstream 2.4.2 with its supported Python and TensorFlow. The model downloader has no access to the audio.

access.why: Retrieves the 2stems model from Deezer directly into a local volume. The song itself is processed without network access.

inputs.what: an audio file containing singing and accompaniment

known_issues: Some sound can bleed between tracks. Downloads about 73 MB of model data on first use.
licence: MIT (code); pre-trained weights come from the author's own release on first use.
